events.title: Live now for Steam Next Fest — demo gameplay (pre-recorded, on loop)
events.summary: During Steam Next Fest we're streaming demo gameplay on a loop. This is a pre-recorded broadcast with no one at the keyboard, so chat may go unanswered. Feedback and bug reports are very welcome in the Discussions — I read every post. Free demo out now — Stages 1–3, and your save carries over to the full game. Controls: keyboard (Arrow keys / WASD to move, Space to dash). Full release: November 5, 2026 — a wishlist helps a solo developer more than anything.

events.title: Free demo out now — join us at Steam Next Fest (Oct 19–26)!
events.summary: Hi everyone, thank you for wishlisting Lazy Drawer: Line Survivors! The free demo is available now, and we're taking part in Steam Next Fest (Oct 19 – Oct 26). What is Lazy Drawer? No guns, no swords, no aiming. The path you walk becomes a line — enemies touching it get shredded, and the moment you close a loop, everything inside blows up at once. The more you trap, the bigger the boom. What's in the demo Stages 1–3, each with its own enemy waves, mid-boss and boss Upgrades, awakenings and hidde

events.title: Streaming & Video Guidelines — monetization OK
events.summary: You are free to stream and make videos of Lazy Drawer: Line Survivors. Streaming, let's plays and videos: OK — on any platform (YouTube, Twitch, TikTok, Niconico, etc.) Monetization: OK — ads, memberships, Super Chats, sponsorships All content: OK — demo and full game, every stage and boss; spoilers are fine Clips, shorts, thumbnails and edited videos: OK No permission or contact needed Credit is not required, but a link to the Steam page is always appreciated Please don't Redistribute the game
